keyword: deep questions to ask your boyfriend

reviews.summary: 10: unlike lists of 50 interchangeable questions, it sorts 48 new ones by depth and stage, and shows how to go first, handle silence and jokes, and follow up the next day. Polish: soften the claim about what made the Aron study work.

dealbreakers: Factual error about a template: the Fortune Cookie note says that questions put 'in order from level 1 to level 4' make 'the easy ones open first'. In src/templates/fortune-cookie/Template.tsx the recipient picks any cookie ('pick a cookie'), crack(i) shows fortunes[i] for whichever cookie he tapped, and nothing makes him open them in order. Even the last cookie, the one with your message, can be opened at any time; it is only marked with a sparkle.
The post says '48 new questions', but 8 of them repeat existing posts almost word for word, 3 of them the hub (see fixes). That claim misleads, and two of the repeats are reused in the 'blush' FAQ.
reviews.summary: Fortune Cookie note wrongly implied the slips open in order; eight questions repeated other posts near-verbatim; three Spanish fixes (va más allá solo en profundidad, haciendo a ti, que hoy ha pasado). All other product, link, study and 7-7-7 claims verified.
10: a level-by-timing table, scripts for going first, silence and jokes, and a text-versus-voice rule, answering every People also ask question for the keyword without duplicating the hub.

applied: Fortune Cookie note (EN/ES): he picks cookies in any order, so use level 1-3 questions that work in any sequence
Eight repeated questions replaced, with the blush FAQ updated
Polish: children question reordered; two Spanish wordings; Aron paragraph softened and mentions taking turns
Writer's own swaps of two more near-repeats ('What makes a life a good one?', 'When do you feel closest to me?')

dealbreakers: "48 new questions" is still not quite true. This is the same kind of error that round 1 counted as a dealbreaker. One line fixes it, in both languages (first fix below).

reviews.summary: 10: the round-2 changes read naturally; the lead, level table, go-first and silence scripts and the honest Aron note make it a page you can act on tonight.

dealbreakers: '48 new questions' (and the hub's new 'For 48 more') is still not true, by the same standard rounds 1 and 2 applied. Two of the 48 are near-copies of questions in existing posts. (1) Level 1 'What's a compliment you got years ago that you still remember?' / «¿Qué cumplido te hicieron hace años y todavía recuerdas?» is the same question as 'What's a compliment you've never forgotten?' / «¿Qué cumplido no has olvidado nunca?» in questions-to-ask-your-boyfriend.ts (lines 115 and 440), the hub that now links here, and again in questions-for-couples.ts line 69. Its short form, 'What's a compliment you still remember?', is the post's lead example, the first FAQ answer and the Fortune Cookie sample slip. A reader who clicks 'For 48 more' from the hub meets the hub's own question in the first sentence. (2) 'What are you quietly good at that you never mention?' repeats 'What's something you're quietly good at?' in questions-for-couples.ts line 60 (ES line 332 «¿Qué se te da bien sin que nadie lo sepa?»). Round 2's polish moved it away from the games deck, but it kept the giveaway phrase 'quietly good at'. Every other one of the 48 was checked by fuzzy match and content-word overlap against all 57 other posts and the games decks: nothing else is near-verbatim.
